description: Representing District 75 means advocating for a largely blue-collar constituency. Florissant and Black Jack are communities where many residents have hands-on jobs, whether in manufacturing, retail, or service industries. Wilke acknowledges this demographic, stating, “We have a lot of people who work with their hands. We are more built on everyday people than white-collar professionals. ”
